title: Unit commitment constrained Nash equilibrium in power markets
summary: Equilibrium modeling for power markets usually assumes convexity of each players' optimization problem. Although the importance of accounting for fixed generation costs and start-up costs, minimum generation levels and/or minimum up-time and down-time restrictions in production scheduling is widely acknowledged, such modeling does not allow for discrete decisions. This paper considers unit commitment constrained Nash equilibria.
